name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Turn a software goal into parallel work, atomic commits, agent prompts, and clear integration handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a goal into parallel, commit-ready work.
interface.longDescription: Publish a provisional DAG immediately, then asynchronously build task-local coding prompts and a task-free whole-system overview for later human-controlled reconciliation.
capabilities: Turn goals into executable work plans
Choose lean, balanced, or thorough prompt depth
Dispatch prompt details with concurrent subagents
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this goal into a provisional DAG from structured repository layout and return the index first. Reserve one task-free whole-system overview job, then dispatch concurrent task-detail jobs, return immediately, and keep reconciliation for a later invocation.
